title: Resolve Windows interop executable paths for queued native jobs
body: The first queued native build ran bash reports/capturespeed/reproduce/native-build.sh and failed before CMake with exit 127 because cmd.exe was not on WSL PATH, even though /mnt/c/Windows/System32/cmd.exe existed. The capture path also used bare powershell.exe. Calling the mapped Windows executables by absolute /mnt/c paths recovered. Add a shared Windows-interop executable discovery/helper for native queue scripts.

title: Pass Windows batch paths to cmd.exe without doubled shell quoting
body: The queued native build reached cmd.exe but failed before CMake because the payload cmd.exe /d /s /c '\C:\vixen-native\nativerunner\reports\capturespeed\reproduce\native-build.bat\ 0e0260abcb90128a9f9d86ee0a7915a9f4327a87' was parsed as a command name containing literal backslashes and quotes. Passing the fixed, space-free batch path and SHA as one /c command string (matching the existing capturespeed runner) avoids the double escaping. Add a shared Windows command-line builder or an invocation smoke check for native build scripts.

title: Expose periodic progress for queued Windows builds
body: The native build payload was killed by the global queue with exit 75 after 336s (log /home/liory/.local/state/undertow/undertow-box-logs/1791953882-build-nativerunner:native-build-9d6e890f0831.log) because it had no WSL-visible CPU or output for 180s. Its status file showed 500/545 targets complete and 0 failures; the Windows build summary buffered output while the queue monitored the WSL cmd.exe wrapper. A 60-second stdout heartbeat inside the queued payload recovers the build while preserving idle-stall detection for silent jobs. Define a native-payload progress contract in the queue or shared runner.

title: Native capture runner omits the staged TBB DLL directory
body: The native CTest launcher runs capture executables from application/main, but MSVC stages their imported tbb12.dll under a compiler-keyed build directory and the runner does not add that directory to PATH. I had to add runtime DLL discovery and PATH setup by hand; consolidate runtime dependency staging into the native capture/build contract.
